senses.gloss: f. (denom. of כֶּרֶס) a leather bag, (as a measure) K’resith containing one S’ah.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 20">Kel. XX</cite>, I Talm. ed. (Mish. ed. a. ed. Dehr. <cite ref="K01184"><he>כריתית</he></cite>, Ar. ed. Koh. <cite ref="K01291"><he>כרתית</he></cite>, denom. of <cite ref="K01071"><he>כַּר</he></cite>).
